company.name: Dropback
company.shortDescription: Dropback develops front office and cap management software for college sports programs.
company.description: Dropback develops front office software for college sports programs, focusing on roster, contract, and financial management. The platform consolidates recruiting, performance, and financial datasets into a private database for athletic departments. Teams build custom analytics models to value athletes, simulate roster scenarios, and optimize compensation structures under revenue-sharing rules. Dropback supports contract workflows with redlining, e-signature, and automated status tracking. It includes tools for cap optimization, multi-year budget planning, and cash flow forecasting across sports. The software also integrates with third-party sports data providers to support discovery and evaluation of high-value talent.
